text: Hey class! I'm Beeswax, your unbeelievably charming and handsome bee assistant.
Bees are super important for our planet. Six things around you matter a lot to bees.
Walk up to one and look at it. Got a question? I'll always BEE here, so interrupt me anytime!
Bee fact found!

label: beehive
text: A beehive! That's home sweet home for bees. Would you like to learn more?

label: native_flower
text: A sunflower! Bees love a sunny snack. Would you like to learn more?

label: honey_jar
text: Honeycomb! Every cell is a tiny honey jar. Would you like to learn more?

label: pebble_dish
text: A bee water dish! Perfect for thirsty bees. Would you like to learn more?

label: bug_spray
text: Uh oh, bug spray! This one is important. Would you like to learn more?

label: bee_hotel
text: A bee hotel! Wild bees check in here. Would you like to learn more?
Got any questions? Bee my guest!
Curious about anything? Just ask me!
Any questions? I'm all ears. Well, all antennae.
Don't worry, I'll BEE right here if you need anything.
No problem! Just buzz me if you change your mind.
Okay! I'll be quiet now. Look at something when you're ready for more.
No worries, we can come back to it.
One down. Five to go.
Two! I'm mildly impressed. Don't tell anyone.
Three down. Halfway! I'd help, but boy bees don't do chores. It's in the contract.
Four. You're making me look good.
Five. One left. Don't you dare slow down.
You found them all! Bee Scout badge earned!
Now you know: flowers feed us, honey takes millions of flower visits, and bug spray hurts bees.
Give bees a home and a drink, and help save the hives. BEE-autiful work, scout!
